name: DropDrawer
summary: Responsive shadcn/ui menu: dropdown on desktop, drawer on mobile, as a drop-in DropdownMenu replacement.
description: A responsive component that switches between a dropdown menu on desktop and a native-feeling drawer on mobile at a configurable 768px breakpoint. It mirrors the shadcn/ui DropdownMenu component API (trigger, content, items, submenus, groups, separators, footer) so migration is mostly find-and-replace, and installs from its GitHub or hosted shadcn registry. Built on Radix UI dropdown-menu and Vaul.
contains: dropdown on desktop, drawer on mobile (768px, configurable)
nested submenus, groups, separators, icons, drawer footer
install via the shadcn CLI from GitHub or a hosted registry
built on Radix UI dropdown-menu and Vaul
